title: MonthCalendar
description: A Monday-first month grid with per-day event counts, keyboard navigation and the selected day's events.

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: Select a day to list its events; arrows, Home / End and PageUp / PageDown move the focus.

MonthCalendarProps.onMonthChange: Called with the first day of the requested month
MonthCalendarProps.events: Events; each day shows how many it has
MonthCalendarProps.onEventClick: Makes the selected day's events clickable
MonthCalendarProps.disabled: Blocks navigation, selection and event clicks
MonthCalendarProps.showSelectedDayEvents: Lists the selected day's events below the grid
MonthCalendarProps.todayLabel: Label of the button returning to the current month
MonthCalendarProps.getDayLabel: Accessible label of a day button (day, number of events)
MonthCalendarProps.getEventsLabel: Accessible label of the selected day's event list
MonthCalendarProps.emptyEventsText: Text shown when the selected day has no events
